channel.title: Prominence II: Hasturian Era Wiki
channel.description: Last 10 notes on Prominence II: Hasturian Era Wiki

item.title: Behind-the-Scenes Mods
item.description: Behind-the-Scenes Mods Plumbing: shared code libraries, compatibility patches, and bugfixes.

item.title: Building & Decoration Mods
item.description: Building & Decoration Mods Chipped / Chipped-Express Chipped adds a huge library of matching decorative block variants; Chipped-Express lets you autocraft those blocks through AE2 or Create instead of clicking a crafting table 200 times.

item.title: Amendments
item.description: Amendments Amendments (by MehVahdJukaar) is a large grab-bag of small vanilla-block tweaks rather than a themed content set, and the pack’s amendments-common.json/amendments-client.json have nearly every tweak turned on.

item.title: Block Swap
item.description: Block Swap Block Swap (by Corgi Taco) is a small utility that silently replaces one block with another, either when a chunk loads/regenerates (retro_gen = true) or via an ID remap table for blocks whose registry name has changed.

item.title: Build Guide
item.description: Build Guide Build Guide (brentmaas) is a client-side only mod (81 lang entries, mostly UI text) that projects wireframe shapes — circles and spheres — into the world so a player can see exactly where to place blocks for a perfect curve.

item.title: Building Wands
item.description: Building Wands Building Wands (nicguzzo) lets a player place a whole run of matching blocks from one item use instead of one block at a time — the classic “point at a wall, extend it 20 blocks” tool.

item.title: Chipped-Express
item.description: Chipped-Express Chipped-Express (by DevDyna, v1.3.2) is a small, purely-functional companion to Chipped.

item.title: Chipped
item.description: Chipped Chipped (by Alex Nijjar, Grimbop, Kekie6, ThatGravyBoat — tagline “Every block needs a friend!”) is the single largest content mod in the Building & Decoration category: its en_us.json carries 7,258 lang entries.

item.title: Connectible Chains
item.description: Connectible Chains Connectible Chains (by legoatoom) lets you shift-click a chain item between two fence posts or walls to string up a decorative catenary — the chain physically sags between the two points instead of rendering as a straight line.

item.title: Connectivity Mod
item.description: Connectivity Mod Despite the name suggesting a block-connection/decoration mod (and its placement in this category), Connectivity (by Someaddons) is actually a network stability fix — it has nothing to do with building or decoration.
